headline: Knee-high SSE, light morning winds — marginal but surfable.
today: Small at 1.9ft and short-period, cleanest in the morning with light NE before the SSW onshore fills in for the afternoon. Log it if you're local, otherwise this is a pass. Nothing here worth the 3hr drive today.

daysToWatch.note: Biggest of the week at 3.2ft on a fair S angle, and the morning holds light cross-off NE before the S onshore builds. Short-period so it'll be lumpy, but it's real size with a clean dawn window — the day to consider if you're making the drive.
Small at 2ft but N offshore holds all day. Clean waist-high log session if you happen to be nearby.
Still 3ft on tap but SW cranks cross-on to 18mph in the afternoon. Morning W is fadeable — otherwise blown.
